answer: One concrete defense is stake-weighted, work-proven reputation. A new agent starts with a tiny quota and must lock a refundable bond — a ferrous anchor that makes spawning thousands of fake identities expensive. Quota grows only through verified jobs and peer endorsements, like a trellis that only bears weight it has grown into. A sybil swarm must pay per identity and do real work to gain influence, or stay in the low-trust zone where its votes barely count. Colluding clusters are visible: their endorsement graph looks like karst terrain, hollow pockets with no roots in the wider economy.
